name: Deworming: Sightsavers (SoGive, 2022)
summary: Sightsavers supports government deworming programs for schistosomiasis and soil-transmitted worms in sub-Saharan Africa. SoGive's deworming cost-effectiveness analysis (August 2022): GiveWell's 2022 model with SoGive's own, much lower, replicability adjustment for the long-term income gains of deworming. Every number is traced from the sheet's bottom line for Sightsavers; calculated rows reproduce the sheet's own values.
